=== Get the config options of the NativePointEncoder

[source,cypher]
----
CALL spatial.encoders.config('NativePointEncoder')
----

.Result

[opts="header",cols="4"]
|===
|name|type|defaultValue|description
|bboxProperty|STRING|bbox|Property name for storing the bounding box of the indexed node
|crs|STRING|wgs84|The CRS to be used, valid values are: `wgs84`
|locationProperty|STRING|location|The name of the property containing the geometry
|===
